A concise explainer video demonstrating the initial setup, SDK integration, and sending a first email would visually validate the ease of use, reducing friction for new developers and accelerating their journey from curiosity to active usage, complementing the existing code snippets.

A video walkthrough would visually showcase the intuitive WYSIWYG interface, demonstrating how users can easily create, customize, and schedule marketing emails without code, making the feature's power and simplicity immediately apparent.
